title: Predicting Generalized Steady States in Aperiodically Forced Mechanical Systems
summary: The existence of generalized steady states (GSSs) in nonlinear mechanical systems under moderate temporally aperiodic forcing has only been shown recently. Here we derive systematic expansions for such GSSs and construct a numerical algorithm that yields explicit and arbitrarily refinable approximations for GSSs without the need for an initial convergence period. This is to be contrasted with a direct numerical integration of the system, whose convergence is hard to assess or is even undefined for short, transient forcing.
